accent.purpose: One emphasis word inside a display headline.

body-small.purpose: Card descriptions, captions and dense supporting copy.

note.purpose: Longer mono notes set in sentence case.

label.purpose: Metadata, tags, buttons, captions, status lines. 11px functional floor.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for entrances and hover state.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Symmetric transitions such as the mobile menu.

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.purpose: One-time title rise and de-blur on page load.

motion.name: hero-frame
motion.purpose: One-time clip reveal on the hero image.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pink pill for the single main action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:46px; padding:0 22px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; background:var(--pink, #ff2d8d); color:var(--ink, #0d0d0c); font-family:var(--font-mono, 'Space Mono', monospace); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:0.13em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--ink, #0d0d0c); color:var(--paper, #f6f6f3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--pink, #ff2d8d); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outlined pill for the secondary action beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:46px; padding:0 22px; border:1px solid rgba(13,13,12,0.34); border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #0d0d0c); font-family:var(--font-mono, 'Space Mono', monospace); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:0.13em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:var(--ink, #0d0d0c); color:var(--paper, #f6f6f3); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--pink, #ff2d8d); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill filter with an active ink state, used on work and toolbox grids.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip ds-chip-active" aria-pressed="true">ALL WORK</button> <button class="ds-chip" aria-pressed="false">FASHION</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 15px; border:1px solid rgba(13,13,12,0.34); border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #0d0d0c); font-family:var(--font-mono, 'Space Mono', monospace); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:background 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:var(--ink, #0d0d0c); } .ds-chip-active { background:var(--ink, #0d0d0c); border-color:var(--ink, #0d0d0c); color:var(--paper, #f6f6f3); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--pink, #ff2d8d); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Metadata Rail
components.description: Top-of-hero mono rail with pink dot separators; stacks to a 2x2 grid on mobile.
components.css: .ds-rail { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px 16px; padding:0 0 14px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(13,13,12,0.16); font-family:var(--font-mono, 'Space Mono', monospace); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:0.13em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink, #0d0d0c); } .ds-rail span { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; } .ds-rail span + span::before { content:''; width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--pink, #ff2d8d); } @media (max-width:720px) { .ds-rail { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; } .ds-rail span + span::before { display:none; } }

components.name: Work Card
components.description: Image-first case card that lifts 2px and scales its image on hover.
components.html: SOUL TERRORCAMPAIGN / 2024
components.css: .ds-work { display:block; text-decoration:none; color:var(--ink, #0d0d0c); transition:transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-work:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-work-media { display:block; overflow:hidden; border-radius:2px; background:#171715; aspect-ratio:4/3; } .ds-work-media img { display:block; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; transition:transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-work:hover .ds-work-media img { transform:scale(1.03); } .ds-work-name { display:block; margin-top:14px; font-family:var(--font-display, 'Anton', sans-serif); font-size:26px; line-height:0.95; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-work-meta { display:block; margin-top:6px; font-family:var(--font-mono, 'Space Mono', monospace); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#6d6961; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Underlined form field with a mono label and pink focus border.
components.css: .ds-field { display:block; } .ds-field-label { display:block; margin-bottom:7px; font-family:var(--font-mono, 'Space Mono', monospace); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:0.13em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#6d6961; } .ds-field-input { width:100%; min-height:46px; padding:0; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(13,13,12,0.34); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #0d0d0c); font-family:var(--font-body, 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif); font-size:16px; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-bottom-color:var(--pink, #ff2d8d); } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--pink, #ff2d8d); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color:#6d6961; }

narrative.overview: The site looks like a campaign proof pulled fresh off the press: neutral press paper, dense black ink, hard rules, and one fluorescent pink marker stroke. It is streetwear-adjacent without being a lookbook, editorial without being a magazine, and direct without looking like a SaaS template. Type does the heavy lifting; photography supplies the proof; ornament is limited to hairlines, a faint paper grain, and the occasional rotated sticker.
keyCharacteristics: Press paper and near-black ink as the base; hot pink as the only accent.
Anton display type at poster scale, Instrument Serif italic for emphasis, Instrument Sans for reading, Space Mono for labels.
Full-height first screens with a metadata rail at the top and the headline anchored low.
Hairline rules, flat surfaces, clipped photography, a 3.5% paper-grain overlay.
Honest labelling: in-house, client, in development. No borrowed proof.

rules.name: The One Marker Rule
rules.body: Pink covers no more than roughly 10% of any screen. If two pink elements compete in one view, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The One Italic Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif italic appears once per headline, on the word that carries the attitude. It is not a second display face.

rules.name: The Rail Rule
rules.body: Metadata is set in Space Mono uppercase at the top or bottom edge of a section, separated by 5px pink dots or hairline rules. It is never mixed into body copy.

rules.name: The Flat Proof Rule
rules.body: A surface earns separation from a rule or a tonal block, never from a drop shadow.

dos: Do keep the first screen to one section.
Do put metadata in a rail at the top or bottom of a hero.
Do use one italic accent word per display headline.
Do label work honestly as in-house, client, or in development.
Do keep body measure at 62–68ch and display tracking at or above -0.04em.
Do make every interactive target at least 44px on touch, and give keyboard focus a visible pink ring.
Do let photography sit in clipped rectangles with a 2px hover scale.
Do use the magazine page's numbered captions as editorial furniture.
donts: Don't add scroll-triggered fades, staggered reveals, or parallax.
Don't put descriptive captions under marketing images.
Don't use pink as a section background except the single toolbox band.
Don't use grey text on pink, or grey text on ink below 4.5:1.
Don't introduce drop shadows, glassmorphism, gradient blobs, or rounded 16px cards.
Don't use a second accent color.
Don't claim client work, results, or testimonials that are not documented.
